top_signals.title: Can’t cook or shower: Indonesians take aim at data centers
top_signals.summary: Frustration is bubbling over in Indonesia and Malaysia — especially in regions bordering Singapore that are seen as a prime location for new tech facilities.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
